name: model-router
description: v0.1.0: MR-003. Every tool call is classified by code against a committed ontology (references/call-ontology.json); only calls that carry a model choice (subagent launches, LLM-backed scripts) are routed, by the table or by Jev at the MR-002 bars; every call is written to a per-session ledger under $GSTACK_PEER_REVIEW_DIR/model-routing/ and route.py score counts it. A hook never blocks a call. The hard limit: a hook cannot change the model answering the current turn, only a subagent launch is rewritten.
